scenario.summary: Guest opens the webstore and the Plumbing category PLP from the Departments menu and verifies the page title. Head of the Plumbing chain (category heading, quick view, facets).
steps: Open the navigation bar and click the category by its label
Verify the PLP title is present
evidence: Head of a dependsOn chain: verifyCategoryHeadingAndListedSubCategories, verifyQuickViewButtonVisible (-> verifyQuickView) and verifyFacetsPanelAndItsProductCount depend on it. First method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): this method declares every record need of the chain and the migrated class keeps them in class fields; the later methods declare none and throw SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when the field is null.

category = CATEGORY_WITH_PRODUCTS {store, minProducts 1, minSubcategories 1, topLevel true}: opened from the Departments menu (top level), the chain checks its sub-category tiles and hovers the first product. Preferred: the sheet label homePage!B14 'Plumbing' (= CategoryCode Plumbing, ZnodeCategoryId 83 in catalog 5; identity categoryCode), not required.
The heading verifyCategoryHeadingAndListedSubCategories asserts (homePage!B28 'PLUMBING', the upper-case rendering of the category name) is declared here from the test source as category.name.

facets = CATEGORY_FACET_VALUES {store, categoryId @category.categoryId, attributeCodes Brand,HeaterType, minValuesPerAttribute 1, minProductsForValue 1, maxProductsForValue 64} for verifyFacetsPanelAndItsProductCount (Brand: PimAttributeId 17, Simple Select, IsFacets; HeaterType: PimAttributeId 139 'Heater Type'). The facet lists and counts that method compares come from TestData.getHashMap tables (BRAND_FACETS_LIST/_PRODUCT_COUNT, HEATER_TYPE_FACETS_LIST/_PRODUCT_COUNT) the scanner does not record (no sources): the migrated method checks facets.facet1/facet2 labels, values and counts (up to 3 values each) instead of the whole sheet lists (user decision 2026-11-10).

Sub-category names verifyCategoryHeadingAndListedSubCategories compares come from TestData.getHashMap(SCENARIO_TEST_DATA_NAME_PLUMBING), not recorded by the scanner: category.subcategory1Name..subcategory4Name.
No sign-in: guest flow (the CentralizedLogin group is a tag only).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
